note: Both sets accurately extract the text claims regarding Title 24 requirements and bulb efficacy examples, but both suffer from significant redundancy by extracting the same facts multiple times. Set A is preferred because it contains fewer total claims (8 vs 10) and less duplication of the bulb equivalence facts (CFL and LED are extracted once in A, but duplicated in B), adhering better to the preference for fewer trivial claims. Neither set extracts data from the 'LIGHTING LEVELS' table, which is a missed opportunity for both.
